title: From Performance to Evidence
summary: Understand the difference between practice, results, evidence, review, and competency decisions.
objectives: Trace a performance result into evidence and authorized review.
Explain why lesson completion alone cannot prove a capability.

vocab.def: A record produced by an activity or assessment.
An authorized evaluation of evidence against defined criteria.
A governed decision about a defined capability based on reviewed evidence.

sections.heading: Keep facts separate
sections.body: The SHF path is Activity Result → Evidence → Authorized Review → Competency Decision. Each step has a different owner and authority.

sections.heading: Feedback supports improvement
sections.body: Evidence can be insufficient without being a personal failure. New practice can create new evidence while preserving earlier history.

practice.answer: That the learner completed the educational lesson, not that a separate capability was verified.

quiz.question: Who may create a governed competency decision?
options: An authorized reviewer using defined criteria
The learner by clicking a button
quiz.answer: An authorized reviewer using defined criteria

lab.objective: Label a synthetic learning record as result, evidence, review, or decision.

reflectionPrompt: Why is an auditable reviewer important when evidence may affect future opportunities?
